title: Sugreeva sends troops to west side
introduction: Sugreeva sends troops to west side to search for Seetha under the leadership of Sushena, the father of lady Tara. Describing the various and magnificent mountains that are situated at the northwest of India, and also the ocean down south to it, namely the present Arabian Sea and almost up to Persian provinces, he orders monkey troops to return within one month's time.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे द्वि चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 42nd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवः तान् हरीन् दक्षिणाम् दिशम् |
अब्रवित् मेघ संकाशम् सुशेषणम् नाम वानरम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvaḥ tān harīn dakṣiṇām diśam |
abravit megha saṃkāśam suśeṣaṇam nāma vānaram |
verses.translation: On sending monkeys to southern direction Sugreeva spoke to a vanara named Sushena who looked like a massive cloud.

glosses.meaning: to [massive] cloud, one who looked like

verses.devanagari:
तारायाः पितरम् राजा श्वशुरम् भीम विक्रमम् |
अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् अभिगम्य प्रणम्य च
verses.iast:
tārāyāḥ pitaram rājā śvaśuram bhīma vikramam |
abravīt prāṃjaliḥ vākyam abhigamya praṇamya ca
verses.translation: On approaching and venerating that awesomely valorous Sushena, the father of Lady Tara, thereby his own father-in-law, king Sugreeva spoke this sentence while adjoining palms in supplication.

verses.devanagari:
महर्षि पुत्रम् मारीचम् अर्चिष्मन्तम् महाकपिम् |
वृ^इतम् कपिवरैः शूरैः महेन्द्र सदृ^इश द्युतिम्
बुद्धि विक्रम सम्पन्नान् वैनतेय सम द्युतिम् |
मरीचि पुत्रान् मारीचान् अर्चिर्माल्यान् महबलान्
ऋषि पुत्रान् च तान् सर्वान् प्रतीचीम् आदिशत् दिशम् |
verses.iast:
maharṣi putram mārīcam arciṣmantam mahākapim |
vṛ^itam kapivaraiḥ śūraiḥ mahendra sadṛ^iśa dyutim
buddhi vikrama sampannān vainateya sama dyutim |
marīci putrān mārīcān arcirmālyān mahabalān
ṛṣi putrān ca tān sarvān pratīcīm ādiśat diśam |
verses.translation: Sugreeva ordered the superb monkey son of great-sage Mareecha, called Arcishman, to western direction, who is a surrounded with exceptional and braving monkeys, a coequal to Indra in his resplendence, endowed with brilliance and bravery and whose speed equals that of the son of Vinata, namely Garuda, the Eagle-vehicle of Vishnu. Along with him Sugreeva also ordered the greatly mighty brothers of Arcishman i.e., the other vanara sons of Sage Mareecha, known as Arcishmaalyaa-s, also called as Mareecha-s. [3, 4, 5a]

glosses.meaning: with braving, monkeys, exceptional ones, surrounded with
in brilliance, bravery, one endowed with
Vinata's, son, equal, in sheen [outstanding speed]
them, all, [called as] Maareecha-s [brothers of Arcishman]

verses.devanagari:
द्वाभ्याम् शत सहस्राभ्याम् कपीनाम् कपि सत्तमाः
सुशेषण प्रमुखा यूयम् वैदेहीम् परिमार्गथ |
verses.iast:
dvābhyām śata sahasrābhyām kapīnām kapi sattamāḥ
suśeṣaṇa pramukhā yūyam vaidehīm parimārgatha |
verses.translation: "Oh, outstanding monkeys, you shall search for Vaidehi proceeding with two hundred thousand monkeys, say two lakhs, and Sushena as your leader." Thus, Sugreeva started to speak to vanara troops.

glosses.meaning: with two, hundred, thousands - two lakhs of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
सौराष्ट्रान् सह बाह्लीकान् चंद्रचित्रान् तथैव च
स्फीतान् जन पदान् रम्यान् विपुलानि पुराणि च |
पुंनाग गहनम् कुक्षिम् वकुल उद्दालक आकुलम्
तथा केतक खँडान् च मार्गध्वम् हरि पुंगवाः |
verses.iast:
saurāṣṭrān saha bāhlīkān caṃdracitrān tathaiva ca
sphītān jana padān ramyān vipulāni purāṇi ca |
puṃnāga gahanam kukṣim vakula uddālaka ākulam
tathā ketaka kha.ṇḍān ca mārgadhvam hari puṃgavāḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, best monkeys, conduct search in the Suraashtra, Baahlika and Candracitra provinces, including their extensive and delightful rural areas and spacious cities, as well as in their woods with Punnaaga trees, areas filled with Vakula, and Uddalaka trees and in their interiors, and even in the thickets of Ketaka trees.
notes: The province of Candracitra, the present day Mathura and is also mentioned as śūra deśa 'Shuura province...' in other mms, and the Suraashtra is identified with present day Sauraashtra, a peninsula in Gujarat.

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यक् स्रोतो वहाः चैव नद्यः शीतजलाः शिवाः
तापसानाम् अरण्यानि कांतारा गिरयः च ये |
तत्र स्थलीः मरुप्राया अति उच्च शिखराः शिलाः
गिरि जाल आवृताम् दुर्गाम् मार्गित्वा पश्चिमाम् दिशम् |
ततः पश्चिमम् आगम्य समुद्रम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ
तिमि नक्र आकुल जलम् गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः |
verses.iast:
pratyak sroto vahāḥ caiva nadyaḥ śītajalāḥ śivāḥ
tāpasānām araṇyāni kāṃtārā girayaḥ ca ye |
tatra sthalīḥ maruprāyā ati ucca śikharāḥ śilāḥ
giri jāla āvṛtām durgām mārgitvā paścimām diśam |
tataḥ paścimam āgamya samudram draṣṭum arhatha
timi nakra ākula jalam gatvā drakśyatha vānarāḥ |
verses.translation: "Oh, vanara-s, search at the blest rivers in the west whose cool water flows westward, as well as in the forests of sages and on the mountains of those forests, and even in lands that are virtually waterless and on the highly towering mountains that are chilly. On searching such an impassable western quarter encircled with enmeshed mountains, then it will be apt of you to come and see Western Ocean. Having come to Western Ocean, you will see seawater ruffled by sharks and crocodiles. [8b, 9, 10, 11a]

glosses.meaning: to west, flowing, flows - rivers flowing westward
waterless, virtually, lands - are there, they also
which of those that are there]
which of those that are there]
which of those that are there]
having gone there - to western ocean

verses.devanagari:
ततः केतक खँडेषु तमाल गहनेषु च
कपयो विहरिष्यन्ति नारिकेल वनेषु च |
verses.iast:
tataḥ ketaka kha.ṇḍeṣu tamāla gahaneṣu ca
kapayo vihariṣyanti nārikela vaneṣu ca |
verses.translation: "Later the monkeys may ramble in the shrubberies of Ketaka plants, in copses of Tamaala plants and in the boscages of coconut trees.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र सीताम् च मार्गध्वम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
वेलातल निवेष्टेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च |
मुरची पत्तनम् चैव रम्यम् चैव जटा पुरम्
अवंतीम् अंगलेपाम् च तथा च अलक्षितम् वनम् |
राष्ट्राणि च विशालानि पत्तनानि ततः ततः
verses.iast:
tatra sītām ca mārgadhvam nilayam rāvaṇasya ca
velātala niveṣṭeṣu parvateṣu vaneṣu ca |
muracī pattanam caiva ramyam caiva jaṭā puram
avaṃtīm aṃgalepām ca tathā ca alakṣitam vanam |
rāṣṭrāṇi ca viśālāni pattanāni tataḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: "Seetha shall be searched along with the residency of Ravana on the mountains that are sitting pretty on the seashore, as well as in the forests on those mountains. Further, the delightful cities available alongshore like Muraci, Jaatapura, Avanti and Angalepa are to be searched together with the forest of Alakshita, including the nearby provinces and spacious townships.
notes: These are said as cities with names of muralī, jaṭīpuram, in other mms, and it is also said to be Maurvi. The said Avanti is not the Avanti already said to the monkeys who were sent to east. is 'un-cared-for' as the thick woods at its periphery make the interiors of forest neglected.

verses.devanagari:
सिंधु सागरयोः चैव संगमे तत्र पर्वतः |
महान् हेम गिरिः नाम शत शृंगो महाद्रुमः
verses.iast:
siṃdhu sāgarayoḥ caiva saṃgame tatra parvataḥ |
mahān hema giriḥ nāma śata śṛṃgo mahādrumaḥ
verses.translation: "At the junction of River Sindhu with the ocean, Mouth of Indus, there is a huge mountain named Hemagiri, Golden-Mountain, which is with hundreds of summits and gigantic trees.

glosses.meaning: of Sindhu, of ocean, at junction

verses.devanagari:
तत्र प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सिंहाः पक्ष गमाः स्थिताः |
तिमि मत्स्य गजाम्ब् चैव नीडानि आरोपयन्ति ते
verses.iast:
tatra prastheṣu ramyeṣu siṃhāḥ pakṣa gamāḥ sthitāḥ |
timi matsya gajāmb caiva nīḍāni āropayanti te
verses.translation: "On the beautiful ridges of that mountain flying-lions are inhibiting and they will be winching sharks, fish and elephant seals to their lairs.

glosses.meaning: with wings, going, lions, are there [flying lions]
sharks, fish, elephants [elephant seals,] also thus
to nests [to lairs in mountains,] uplifts [winching.]

verses.devanagari:
तानि नीडानि सिंहानाम् गिरि शृंग गताः च ये |
दृप्ताः तृप्ताः च मातंगाः तोयद स्वन निःस्वनाः
विचरन्ति विशाले अस्मिन् तोय पूर्णे समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
tāni nīḍāni siṃhānām giri śṛṃga gatāḥ ca ye |
dṛptāḥ tṛptāḥ ca mātaṃgāḥ toyada svana niḥsvanāḥ
vicaranti viśāle asmin toya pūrṇe samantataḥ |
verses.translation: "The elephants inhibiting on the top of that mountain are contended and conceited, and trumpeting like thunderous clouds they will be moving everywhere in that vast area of the mountain abutted by water and near at the lairs of flying-lions.

glosses.meaning: water, giver [cloud,] sound [thunder,] emitting, sound [trumpeting like thundering clouds]
water, filled [water abutted area of the mountain]

verses.devanagari:
तस्य शृंगम् दिव स्पर्शम् कांचनम् चित्र पादपम्
सर्वम् आशु विचेतव्यम् कपिभिः काम रूपिभिः |
verses.iast:
tasya śṛṃgam diva sparśam kāṃcanam citra pādapam
sarvam āśu vicetavyam kapibhiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ |
verses.translation: "The monkeys who can change their guise by their wish have to quickly and entirely search the golden peak of that Hemagiri which will be touching the sky and which has amazing trees on it.

verses.devanagari:
कोटिम् तत्र समुद्रे तु कांचनीम् शत योजनम्
दुर्दर्शाम् पारियात्रस्य गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः |
verses.iast:
koṭim tatra samudre tu kāṃcanīm śata yojanam
durdarśām pāriyātrasya gatā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ |
verses.translation: "On your seagoing there, oh, vanara-s, you will see the golden peak of a waterlogged mountain called Mt. Paariyaatra, which peak will be hundred yojana-s in height, and which is difficult to see as it will be blindingly glittering.

glosses.meaning: impossible, to see [because it is blindingly glittering]

verses.devanagari:
कोट्यः तत्र चतुर्विंशत् गंधर्वाणाम् तरस्विनाम्
वसन्ति अग्नि निकाशानाम् घोराणाम् काम रूपिणाम् |
verses.iast:
koṭyaḥ tatra caturviṃśat gaṃdharvāṇām tarasvinām
vasanti agni nikāśānām ghorāṇām kāma rūpiṇām |
verses.translation: "Twenty four crores of mighty and atrocious Gandharva-s whose glow is similar to the fire and who can change their guise at their wish are living there on that mountain Paariyaatra.
notes: The Gandharva-s said here are not the celestial musicians but human Gandharva-s and the Paariyaatra Mountain may perhaps belong to one in Suleiman Range, now in Pakistan, but not the one among Vindhya Range.

glosses.meaning: four, twenty, crores, [a host of twenty-four crores]

verses.devanagari:
पावक अर्चिः प्रतीकाशाः समवेताः समन्ततः
न अति आसादयित्वाः ते वानरैः भीम विक्रमैः |
verses.iast:
pāvaka arciḥ pratīkāśāḥ samavetāḥ samantataḥ
na ati āsādayitvāḥ te vānaraiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ |
verses.translation: "If those Gandharva-s who resemble the tongues of fire are given offence, they will be thronging together from everywhere, as such even awfully courageous vanara-s shall not provoke them.

glosses.meaning: fire, tongues of, those that are reflective of - who resemble

verses.devanagari:
न अदेयम् च फलम् तस्मात् देशात् किंचित् प्लवंगमैः
दुरासदा हि ते वीराः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः |
फल मूलानि ते तत्र रक्षन्ते भीम विक्रमाः
verses.iast:
na adeyam ca phalam tasmāt deśāt kiṃcit plavaṃgamaiḥ
durāsadā hi te vīrāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ |
phala mūlāni te tatra rakṣante bhīma vikramāḥ
verses.translation: "And the fly-jumpers shall not pluck at least a fruit in that province. Because those assiduous, highly mighty and valiant Gandharva-s are impossible for overtures, isn't it. Moreover, those appallingly audacious Gandharva-s will be safeguarding fruits and tubers there.
notes: This area must be in and around present day Afghanistan because it is famous for dry fruits and it is the age-old practice of Kabuli Walla-s to sell most delicious dry-fruits. When they grow that kind of high-grade fruits which orchardist allows a monkey to pluck and plunder them.

glosses.meaning: fruit, at least, not, to be picked, also

verses.devanagari:
तत्र यत्नः च कर्तव्यो मार्गितव्या च जानकी |
न हि तेभ्यो भयम् किंचित् कपित्वम् अनुवर्तताम्
verses.iast:
tatra yatnaḥ ca kartavyo mārgitavyā ca jānakī |
na hi tebhyo bhayam kiṃcit kapitvam anuvartatām
verses.translation: "There you have to put yourself in devoir and search for Janaki. In the event of your following just monkey-hood and its antics, without becoming adventuresome, there will be no scare from those Gandharva-s. Then you proceed from that Mt. Paariyaatra to Mt. Vajra.

glosses.meaning: to those who are following it - who practise monkey tricks

verses.devanagari:
तत्र वैदूर्य वर्णाभो वज्र संस्थान संस्थितः |
नाना द्रुम लता आकीर्णो वज्रः नाम महागिरिः
श्रीमान् समुदितः तत्र योजनानाम् शतम् समम् |
गुहाः तत्र विचेतव्याः प्रयत्नेन प्लवंगमाः
verses.iast:
tatra vaidūrya varṇābho vajra saṃsthāna saṃsthitaḥ |
nānā druma latā ākīrṇo vajraḥ nāma mahāgiriḥ
śrīmān samuditaḥ tatra yojanānām śatam samam |
guhāḥ tatra vicetavyāḥ prayatnena plavaṃgamāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, fly-jumpers, there is a great mountain named Mt. Vajra in that sea beyond Mt. Paariyaatra. It will be with a shine similar to the hue of the gemstone lapis, and it will be standing like a diamond in its shape, hence it is diamondiferous. There that glorious mountain will be soaring high, squarely for a hundred yojana-s, and diverse trees and climbers will be spreading over it. There, on that mountain you have to search pursuantly including its caverns.

glosses.meaning: there - in sea next to Mt. Paariyaatra
lapis gemstone, hue, similar in shine
a diamond, in structure, standing - standing like a diamond in its shape

verses.devanagari:
चतुर् भागे समुद्रस्य चक्रवान् नाम पर्वतः |
तत्र चक्रम् सहस्रारम् निर्मितम् विश्वकर्मणा
verses.iast:
catur bhāge samudrasya cakravān nāma parvataḥ |
tatra cakram sahasrāram nirmitam viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: "In the fourth quarter of that ocean from land a mountain named Cakravaan is there. Vishvakarma, the Divine Architect, constructed a thousand-spoked wheel on it.
notes: This is not just a wheel with thousand spokes, but said to be a machine of weaponry with thousand parts or sub-weapons. The Divine Architect Vishvakarma constructs such marvellous things not only for to gods, but even to the demons, while coming under duress, as and when demons conquer Indra's paradise. In the following verses, a connected legend is also touched.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र पंचजनम् हत्वा हयग्रीवम् च दानवम् |
आजहार ततः चक्रम् शंखम् च पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.iast:
tatra paṃcajanam hatvā hayagrīvam ca dānavam |
ājahāra tataḥ cakram śaṃkham ca puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: puraaNa/Legend: "Once upon a time in the crusades of gods-demons, Vishnu assuming the form of puroSottama 'Supreme Person' slew the horse-faced demon named Hayagreeva on that mountain, and snatched away the wheel-weapon from him. Until then, this wheel-weapon existed under the custody of that demon Hayagreeva. Purushottama also put another demon Pancajana to death on that very mountain and took away his backbone, which is a conch-shell. Thus the conch-shell handled by Vishnu is known as paancha janya shankha 'Paanchajanya conch.' Thus, this Cakravaan named mountain assumes legendary importance to search for Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च |
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
verses.iast:
tasya sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca |
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: "Vaidehi is to be searched on the delightful cliffs of that Mt. Cakravaan and also in its spacious caves, together with Ravana, and search for her here, there, and everywhere.

glosses.meaning: there, there - here, there, and everywhere.

verses.devanagari:
योजनानि चतुः षष्टिः वराहो नाम पर्वतः |
सुवर्ण शृंगः सुमहान् अगाधे वरुण आलये
verses.iast:
yojanāni catuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ varāho nāma parvataḥ |
suvarṇa śṛṃgaḥ sumahān agādhe varuṇa ālaye
verses.translation: "After sixty-four yojana-s another very great mountain with golden peaks is there in abyss of the abode of Rain-god, namely the ocean, and it is named as Mt. Varaaha.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र प्राक् ज्योतिषम् नाम जातरूपमयम् पुरम् |
यस्मिन् वसति दुष्ट आत्मा नरको नाम दानवः
verses.iast:
tatra prāk jyotiṣam nāma jātarūpamayam puram |
yasmin vasati duṣṭa ātmā narako nāma dānavaḥ
verses.translation: "A city named Praagjyotisha is there which is completely golden, wherein the evil-minded demon named Naraka is living.
notes: This Praagjyotisha is held as the present Assam as has been referred by Kalidasa in his works and some say that this place should not have been referred here. The inclusion of this verse is said to be the problem with the copyist. S.M. Ali in 'The Geography of the Puranas' says: 'this was the famous janapada on the fringe of the Eastern country...' and it corresponds roughly with the middle Brahmaputra valley...' The name is derived as prāk 'firstly, easterly...' jyotiṣ 'planet, Sun, and his light'' that is to say, 'the place which takes the first light...', that is the east of India...' i.e., Assam. The said demon Naraka is not just "the buffalo-demon"who was eliminated by Goddess Durga.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च |
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
verses.iast:
tatra sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca |
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: "There on the delightful cliffs and spacious caves of that Mt. Varaaha, including that city Praagjyotisha, Ravana shall be searched together with Vaidehi.

glosses.meaning: there [on Mt. Varaaha,] on delightful, cliffs

verses.devanagari:
तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् कांचनान् अन्तर दर्शनम् |
पर्वतः सर्व सौवर्णो धारा प्रस्रवण आयुतः
verses.iast:
tam atikramya śailendram kāṃcanān antara darśanam |
parvataḥ sarva sauvarṇo dhārā prasravaṇa āyutaḥ
verses.translation: "On ranging from that best Mt. Varaaha, whose caves are inlaid with gold-deposits apparent to the naked eye, there is an entirely golden mountain containing waterfalls and rapids called Meghavanta.

glosses.meaning: with gold-deposits, inlaid, appears [with golden caves]
entirely, golden, mountain - is there, called Meghavanta.

verses.devanagari:
तम् गजाः च वराहाः च सिंहा व्याघ्राः च सर्वतः |
अभिगर्जन्ति सततम् तेन शब्देन दर्पिताः
verses.iast:
tam gajāḥ ca varāhāḥ ca siṃhā vyāghrāḥ ca sarvataḥ |
abhigar.hjanti satatam tena śabdena darpitāḥ
verses.translation: "Listening the sonorous sounds of waterfalls and rapids of that mountain, and construing them to be the roars of their opponent beasts, the elephants, wild boars, lions, and tigers will always be facing that mountain and roaring proud-heartedly all around it, by which that Mt. Meghavanta itself appears to be roaring, proud-heartedly.

glosses.itrans: gajaaH ca varaahaaH ca simhaa vyaaghraaH ca
glosses.iast: gajāḥ ca varāhāḥ ca simhā vyāghrāḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: गजाः च वराहाः च सिम्हा व्याघ्राः च
glosses.meaning: elephants, also wild-boars, also, lions, tigers, also
by its [mountain's,] sound [on listening the reverberating sounds of rapids and falls of that mountain]

verses.devanagari:
यस्मिन् हरि हयः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः |
अभिषिक्तः सुरै राजा मेघो नाम स पर्वतः
verses.iast:
yasmin hari hayaḥ śrīmān mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ |
abhiṣiktaḥ surai rājā megho nāma sa parvataḥ
verses.translation: "On which mountain the distinguished Mahendra, whose horses are green and who is the controller of demon Paka, is anointed by gods as their king, such a mountain is this named Mt. Megha, or Mt. Meghavanta, which you have to scour.

glosses.meaning: green, horses - one who has, Indra

verses.devanagari:
तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् महेन्द्र परिपालितम् |
षष्टिम् गिरि सहस्राणि कांचनानि गमिष्यथ
तरुण आदित्य वर्णानि भ्राजमानानि सर्वतः |
जातरूपमयैः वृक्षैः शोभितानि सुपुष्पितैः
verses.iast:
tam atikramya śailendram mahendra paripālitam |
ṣaṣṭim giri sahasrāṇi kāṃcanāni gamiṣyatha
taruṇa āditya varṇāni bhrājamānāni sarvataḥ |
jātarūpamayaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ śobhitāni supuṣpitaiḥ
verses.translation: "On going further from that best mountain ruled by Mahendra, namely Mt. Meghavanta, you shall go to the range of sixty thousand golden mountains. Those mountains are radiant all around with the tinge of young Sun, and with the resplendence of fully flowered trees which are wholly golden in hue.

glosses.meaning: that, mountain the best - Mt. Meghavanta
mountain, thousands [a range of sixty thousand mountains]

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् मध्ये स्थितो राजा मेरुः उत्तम पर्वतः |
आदित्येन प्रसन्नेन शैलो दत्त वरः पुरा
verses.iast:
teṣām madhye sthito rājā meruḥ uttama parvataḥ |
ādityena prasannena śailo datta varaḥ purā
verses.translation: "There is a unique and kingly mountain in the midst of that range of golden mountains, which is called Mt. Meru, or Saavrni Meru, to which mountain generous Sun has once given a boon.

verses.devanagari:
तेन एवम् उक्तः शैलेन्द्रः सर्व एव त्वत् आश्रयाः |
मत् प्रसादात् भविष्यन्ति दिवा रात्रौ च कांचनाः
त्वयि ये च अपि वत्स्यन्ति देव गन्धर्व दानवाः |
ते भविष्यन्ति भक्ताः च प्रभया कांचन प्रभाः
verses.iast:
tena evam uktaḥ śailendraḥ sarva eva tvat āśrayāḥ |
mat prasādāt bhaviṣyanti divā rātrau ca kāṃcanāḥ
tvayi ye ca api vatsyanti deva gandharva dānavāḥ |
te bhaviṣyanti bhaktāḥ ca prabhayā kāṃcana prabhāḥ
verses.translation: "The Sun said to that unique Mt. Meru Saavarni in this way, 'by my beneficence whatever that is sheltered by you, say trees, climbers, rapids, boulders, all of them will transmute into golden hue, either by day or by night. Even those that reside on you, say gods, gandharva-s, or demons, they too shall thrive as my votaries and as far as their resplendence is concerned they will be glittering like gold, i.e., in the ochry golden hue of the eventide.

glosses.meaning: all of the - [whatever trees, boulders, brooks,] thus
votaries [of mine, i.e., the Sun,] also

verses.devanagari:
विश्वेदेवाः च वसवो मरुतः च दिव ओकसः |
आगत्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् मेरुम् उत्तम पर्वतम्
आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ति तैः च सूर्यो अभिपूजितः |
अदृश्यः सर्व भूतानाम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम्
verses.iast:
viśvedevāḥ ca vasavo marutaḥ ca diva okasaḥ |
āgatya paścimām saṃdhyām merum uttama parvatam
ādityam upatiṣṭhanti taiḥ ca sūryo abhipūjitaḥ |
adṛśyaḥ sarva bhūtānām astam gacchati parvatam
verses.translation: "On their coming to that unique mountain Mt. Meru Saavarni at vespers Vishvedeva-s, Vasava-s, Marut-s, and the other celestials will bide their time for the dusking Sun, and when they all have worshipped him, the Sun goes to the Mt. Astagiri, the Dusking Mountain, and evanishes for all beings for that day.
notes: The above list may not mention others but it is construed to be inclusive of ekādaśa rudra-s, who are twenty-one in number, while the viśvedevāḥ are thirteen, vasavāḥ are eight, maruts are seven, ādityā-s 'the other Suns in other galaxies...' are twelve.

glosses.meaning: nearby, sit tight - as in seated worship - they will worship

verses.devanagari:
योजनानाम् सहस्राणि दश तानि दिवाकरः |
मुहूर्त अर्धेन तम् शीघ्रम् अभियाति शिल उच्चयम्
verses.iast:
yojanānām sahasrāṇi daśa tāni divākaraḥ |
muhūrta ardhena tam śīghram abhiyāti śila uccayam
verses.translation: "The Sun courses across those ten thousand yojana-s from Mt. Meru Saavarni to Mt. Astaadri in one and half hours, and quickly reaches Mt. Astagiri, or Mt. Dusk.

glosses.meaning: towards mountain, highest, [Mt. Astagiri, Mt. Dusk]

verses.devanagari:
शृंगे तस्य महत् दिव्यम् भवनम् सूर्य संनिभम् |
प्रासाद गण संबाधम् विहितम् विश्वकर्मणा
verses.iast:
śṛṃge tasya mahat divyam bhavanam sūrya saṃnibham |
prāsāda gaṇa sambādham vihitam viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: "On the pinnacle of Mt. Astagiri, or the Mt. Dusk, there is a supreme and heavenly manor-house compacted with multi-storied buildings, which in shine will be similar to Sun and which is arranged by Vishvakarma, the Divine Architect.

glosses.meaning: building with stories, multi, compacted with

verses.devanagari:
शोभितम् तरुभिः चित्रैः नाना पक्षि समाकुलैः |
निकेतम् पाश हस्तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
śobhitam tarubhiḥ citraiḥ nānā pakṣi samākulaiḥ |
niketam pāśa hastasya varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "That villa is brightened by amazing trees, on which diverse birds will be twittering musically, belongs to the great-souled Varuna, the Rain-god, who wields a tether.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तरा मेरुम् अस्तम् च तालो दश शिरा महान् |
जातरूपमयः श्रीमान् भ्राजते चित्र वेदिकः
verses.iast:
antarā merum astam ca tālo daśa śirā mahān |
jātarūpamayaḥ śrīmān bhrājate citra vedikaḥ
verses.translation: "In between Mt. Meru and Mt. Astaadri there is a gigantic ten-leaved Date-palm-tree, which is completely golden and shines forth with a marvellous podium.
notes: This area must be the present day Arabian and the ancient Persian province, because the Date-palm tree is the highly respected tree at there or even throughout south East Asia. The three kinds of Dates trees are called as dry-grass-palm trees, as said in Amara Kosha. kharjūra, ketakī, talī, kharjūrī ca tṛṇa drumā: amara kośa 'Date, Pandamus odara tissimus, Corypha Talliera and Wild Date are dry-grass-palms, and these grow in abundance around oases.

glosses.meaning: Mt. Meru, Mt. Astaadri [Mt. Dusk,] also

verses.devanagari:
तेषु सर्वेषु दुर्गेषु सरस्सु च सरित्सु च |
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
verses.iast:
teṣu sarveṣu durgeṣu sarassu ca saritsu ca |
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: "On all those mountains, lakesides and riversides Vaidehi shall be searched together with Ravana, far and wide.

verses.devanagari:
यत्र तिष्ठति धर्मज्ञः तपसा स्वेन भावितः |
मेरु सावर्णिर् इति एष ख्यातो वै ब्रह्मणा समः
verses.iast:
yatra tiṣṭhati dharmajñaḥ tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ |
meru sāvarṇir iti eṣa khyāto vai brahmaṇā samaḥ
verses.translation: "This is where the virtue-knower, an enlightened one by his own asceticism, a selfsame personality to Brahma and one renowned as Sage Merusaavarni indeed resides.

glosses.meaning: by his own, asceticism, an enlightened one
where, he abides, indeed - that place is this Mt. Meru Saavarni.

verses.devanagari:
प्रष्टव्यो मेरुसावर्णिः महर्षिः सूर्य संनिभः |
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रवृत्तिम् मैथिलीम् प्रति
verses.iast:
praṣṭavyo merusāvarṇiḥ maharṣiḥ sūrya saṃnibhaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pravṛttim maithilīm prati
verses.translation: "And that sage Merusaavarni who is Sun-similar in his shine can be asked, only on your prostration before him in veneration, about the tidings of Maithili, and her whereabouts.

glosses.meaning: with head-bent, onto ground, venerating - prostration yourself before him
of Maithili, about - tidings about Maithili
her whereabouts, he can be asked.

verses.devanagari:
एतावत् जीव लोकस्य भास्करो रजनी क्षये |
कृत्वा वितिमिरम् सर्वम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम्
verses.iast:
etāvat jīva lokasya bhāskaro rajanī kṣaye |
kṛtvā vitimiram sarvam astam gacchati parvatam
verses.translation: "On effacing the utter darkness of all the mortal world up to here, the illuminator of mortal world and the decliner of night, namely the Sun, will go to the Mt. Astagiri, say Mt. Dusk.

glosses.meaning: to Astagiri, mountain [Mt. Dusk,] goes to.

verses.devanagari:
एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गन्तुम् वानर पुंगवाः |
अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम्
verses.iast:
etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gantum vānara puṃgavāḥ |
abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param
verses.translation: "It is possible for the vanara-s to go only up to there, oh, best vanara-s, and we have no knowledge of those sunless and boundless realms available far and beyond.
notes: In 'The Ancient Geography of India' K. Basu records: 'the reader should notice here that Valmiki makes mention of a few places only, most of which are mountains in the west and ends with the poetic land of the setting Sun. This shows that little was known at that time of the famed nations of the west, in spite of the great antiquity claimed by Egypt, Assyria, and Greece and one might be led to the thinking that these nations had not yet risen to power in the time of Valmiki, or if they existed at all, communication was not yet opened between them and the Indian Aryans...'

The words a+bhāskaram, a + maryādam are also taken in the sense, 'without, enlightenment; without, proper conduct, i.e., propriety...' 'Those places are with primitives who are unenlightened and with impropriety, that are incongruous with Ancient Indian principle of living...' Thus, these cultures west to Persia are held as pre-Babylonian or pre-Assyrian cultures. Moreover, it is assumed that Sugreeva has said this way: 'because Ravana is a highly educated and cultured demon, in his own way, he too despises those lowly cultures despite of his obstinacy. For sure, he will not be there with Seetha, and hence Seetha need not be searched in those countries.'

glosses.meaning: by vanara-s, to go, it is possible
not, we know - I do not know.

verses.devanagari:
अवगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च |
अस्तम् पर्वतम् आसाद्य पूर्णे मासे निवर्तत
verses.iast:
avagamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca |
astam parvatam āsādya pūrṇe māse nivartata
verses.translation: "You shall return within a month on knowing about Vaidehi and also about the residency of Ravana, or on your reaching Mt. Astagiri, say Mt. Dusk.

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वम् मासान् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम |
सह एव शूरो युष्माभिः श्वशुरो मे गमिष्यति
verses.iast:
ūrdhvam māsān na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama |
saha eva śūro yuṣmābhiḥ śvaśuro me gamiṣyati
verses.translation: "And none shall stay behind for more than a month, and if anyone stays, I have to exercise coup de grace in his respect. By the way, my valorous father-in-law, namely Sushena, is proceeding along with you.

glosses.meaning: than a month, above [more than,] not, to stay away
to me, executable, [he] becomes - I have to exercise coup de grace

verses.devanagari:
श्रोतव्यम् सर्वम् एतस्य भवद्भिः दिष्ट कारिभिः |
गुरुः एष महाबाहुः श्वशुरो मे महाबलः
verses.iast:
śrotavyam sarvam etasya bhavadbhiḥ diṣṭa kāribhiḥ |
guruḥ eṣa mahābāhuḥ śvaśuro me mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "As achievers of ordered tasks you shall give heed to all of the orders given by him. He who is highly dextrous and great mighty such a Sushena is my father-in-law, thus he is a venerable to me, as well as to you.

glosses.meaning: all [orders,] give ear to - give heed to

verses.devanagari:
भवन्तः च अपि विक्रान्ताः प्रमाणम् सर्वे एव हि |
प्रमाणम् एनम् संस्थाप्य पश्यध्वम् पश्चिमाम् दिशम्
verses.iast:
bhavantaḥ ca api vikrāntāḥ pramāṇam sarve eva hi |
pramāṇam enam saṃsthāpya paśyadhvam paścimām diśam
verses.translation: "Even all of you are triumphant ones and indeed archetypes by yourselves, but instituting him as your archetype you shall search the western direction.

glosses.meaning: western, direction, you shall see - search.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टायाम् तु नरेन्द्रस्या पत्न्याम् अमित तेजसः |
कृत कृत्या भविष्यामः कृतस्य प्रतिकर्मणा
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭāyām tu narendrasyā patnyām amita tejasaḥ |
kṛta kṛtyā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtasya pratikarmaṇā
verses.translation: "We all fulfil ourselves in reciprocating him who has done good to us, only if we can locate Seetha, the wife of the king of humans whose vitality is unlimited, namely Rama.

glosses.meaning: what has been done [for us,] in turn, by doing [by reciprocating]

verses.devanagari:
अतो अन्यत् अपि यत् कार्यम् कार्यस्य अस्य प्रियम् भवेत् |
संप्रधार्य भवद्भिः च देश काल अर्थ संहितम्
verses.iast:
ato anyat api yat kāryam kāryasya asya priyam bhavet |
sampradhārya bhavadbhiḥ ca deśa kāla artha saṃhitam
verses.translation: "Even if any other task than this is there, that which shall be conducive to this task, and which shall also be conducive to time, place and purpose, you shall undertake that task also on deciding about it among yourselves." Sugreeva spoke thus to the monkeys going to western direction.

glosses.meaning: place, time, purpose, verily, which will be conducive to
by you all, on deciding, also

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुषेण प्रमुखाः प्लवंगमाः
सुग्रीव वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्य |
आमंत्र्य सर्वे प्लवगाधिपम् ते
जग्मुर् दिशम् ताम् वरुण अभिगुप्ताम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ suṣeṇa pramukhāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ
sugrīva vākyam nipuṇam niśamya |
āmaṃtrya sarve plavagādhipam te
jagmur diśam tām varuṇa abhiguptām
verses.translation: On hearing the sentences of Sugreeva sedulously, then Sushena and the other important fly-jumpers took leave of the king of fly-jumpers, namely Sugreeva, and proceeded along with their individual troops to that western direction which is well cloistered by Varuna, the Rain-god.
